proofBoundary: The target set is the 421 streamed GfxImages from the canonical frozen retail GfxWorld manifest. Shared base.ipak census admission requires one exact nameHash+dataHash pair or one unique streamed-part dataHash. Name-hash-only hits are non-admissible. The union marks only images not already covered by the retail map IPAK as base additions. Payload promotion still requires byte extraction, recomputed CRC29, IWI parse, and retained dimension validation.
